visual_description: A prominent black horizontal banner with bold, all-caps cream text that reads 'FREE DELIVERY ON ORDERS $100+ • ARRIVES BY 2/13'. The text is centered and stands out against the black background, spanning the full width of the email. The image is positioned directly beneath the logo/header section at the top of the email.
purpose: To communicate an urgent promotional offer (free delivery on qualifying orders) and a key shipping cutoff/date to drive immediate action. Serves as a high-visibility, above-the-fold incentive to boost conversions.
rag_text: Top preheader section features a full-width black bar with bold, cream all-caps text announcing 'FREE DELIVERY ON ORDERS $100+ • ARRIVES BY 2/13', immediately under the logo. The function is to highlight a shipping incentive and drive urgency before the main content.
